about.title: Welcome to The New Horizons Institute of Technology
about.text: NHIT opened its first academic session on 16 August 2007 at Durgapur. Today it is one of eastern India’s largest diploma engineering institutes by student intake — with six diploma branches, a Private ITI, and a first pass-out batch that set the standard:
about.textBold: 85% moved into jobs or B.Tech lateral entry
checklist: Six diploma branches — three years, six semesters each
MoUs with CSIR-CMERI (Govt. of India) and NEN; HCL tie-up
Life Member, Institution of Engineers (India); ISTE member

careerJourney.ctaText: Admissions open for Session 2026–27. Scholarships available for meritorious students across all 6 diploma engineering streams.

stages.title: The Aspiring School Student
stages.desc: You have just completed Class 10 with a spark of engineering curiosity. Rather than spending 2 years on rote memorization, NHIT offers a direct, practical gateway into technical education where foundational science meets hands-on discovery.

stages.title: Welcome to NHIT Durgapur
stages.desc: Stepping into Eastern India’s premier polytechnic campus. Over 2,000 peers, 40+ state-of-the-art laboratories, a digital library, and dedicated faculty mentor groups welcome you into a vibrant, collaborative engineering community.

stages.title: Hands-On Labs from Semester One
stages.desc: At NHIT, you don’t wait until final year to touch real machinery. From your very first semester, you work directly with CNC machines, automobile engine teardowns, electrical grids, civil surveying total stations, and programming compilers.

stages.title: Rigorous Soft Skills & Personality Prep
stages.desc: Technical skills alone won’t win the boardroom. NHIT’s dedicated Training & Placement Cell conducts structured communication training, mock group discussions, personal interview drills, and corporate etiquette bootcamps.

stages.title: Industry-Ready & Competitive Exams
stages.desc: Real-world exposure via institutional MoUs with CSIR-CMERI Durgapur, National Entrepreneurship Network (NEN), and technology tie-ups with HCL. VOCLET coaching for B.Tech lateral entry alongside live industrial internships.

stages.title: Placed Engineer & Future Leader
stages.desc: From an uncertain school-leaver to an empowered, certified diploma engineer. Holding an official offer letter or stepping into prestigious government engineering colleges through lateral entry — your transformation is complete.
